title: apium ternatum var. genuinum
intro: Apium ternatum var. genuinum, commonly known as Mountain Celery or Ternate Celery, is a variety of the Apium ternatum plant, which belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Celery include soothing digestive issues, reducing pain and inflammation, and treating respiratory problems such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Celery include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
